excerpt: Most arcade ROI claims are vague or inflated. This analysis models three explicit scenarios—pessimistic, neutral, and optimistic—with transparent assumptions so you can verify every number. On a base case of $75 weekly drop, a commercial bartop machine pays for itself in roughly 14 months and then nets about $304 monthly.
